# The shared outgoing client is cached after observer registration

The EWS constructor supplies a client factory to shared OutgoingServer state. client() builds the client and registers its removal observer before setting OnceCell. If factory or observer setup fails, the cache remains unset and a later call can invoke the factory again; the only-once comment describes successful initialization. A matching removal notification queues shutdown and removes the observer. The service notifies before clearing preferences, but the queued shutdown is not awaited by that notification. No lifecycle or failure-injection run was performed.

Scope: Rust outgoing client initialization and removal lifetime.
